steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each result and open action is matched to its target and its owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Result with no target
findings.fix: Set the target for the result

findings.title: Trend with fewer than three data points
findings.fix: Add the data or drop the trend

outcome.notChecked: Decisions the management review will take; figures not in the reports.

example:

pros: Checks a result with no target, a trend with fewer than three data points, and an open action with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Decisions the management review will take; figures not in the reports.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-management-review-input skill on the records for this review.
